name: reppit-workspace
description: Reddit for repos and agent skills, with the front page delivered into your agent.

scripts.test:rust: cargo test --locked --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path packages/cli-rs/Cargo.toml
